sections.takeaway_fil: Kaso: Masakit ang tiyan ni Rosa at lumalala ang sakit
sections.takeaway_en: Case: Rosa has worsening stomach pain and wants to drink Tsaang…

sections.takeaway_fil: Itugma ang dalawang Tsaang gubat card; piliin ang Carmona retusa, dahon, gamit at ligtas na susunod na hakbang.
sections.takeaway_en: Match two Tsaang gubat cards; choose Carmona retusa, leaves, use and safe next step.

sections.takeaway_fil: Itugma ang bahagi sa nakasulat na source; hindi pa ito dose.
sections.takeaway_en: Match the part to the written source; this is not a dose.

check.prompt_fil: Aling bahagi ng Tsaang gubat ang nakalista sa card?
check.prompt_en: Which Tsaang gubat part is listed on the card?

options.fil: Anumang bahagi ng halaman sa bakuran kahit hindi ito nakumpirmang Tsaang gubat.
options.en: Any part of a yard plant even when its identity as Tsaang gubat is unconfirmed.

options.fil: Hindi kailangang malaman ang botanical name.
options.en: The botanical name need not be checked.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Hindi ligtas ang hindi nakumpirmang bahagi at pagkakakilanlan. 2: Itugma ang bahagi sa nakasulat na source; hindi pa ito dose. 3: Magkapareho ang tawag sa ilang magkakaibang halaman.
check.feedback_en: 1: Unconfirmed part and identity are unsafe. 2: Match the part to the written source; this is not a dose. 3: Common names may cover different plants.

sections.takeaway_fil: Para sa Tsaang gubat, itugma ang botanical name, bahagi at nakalistang gamit. Ipaliwanag ang hangganan at konsultasyon.
sections.takeaway_en: For Tsaang gubat, match the botanical name, plant part and listed use. Explain the boundary and consultation need.

sections.takeaway_fil: Kumpirmahin ang saklaw at kailangan sa tamang tao.
sections.takeaway_en: Confirm boundaries and requirements with the appropriate person.

sections.takeaway_fil: Kumpirmahin ang identity, sintomas at saklaw bago magpayo.
sections.takeaway_en: Confirm identity, symptoms and scope before advice.

check.prompt_fil: Ano ang ligtas na sagot sa kaso ni Tsaang gubat?
check.prompt_en: What is the safe response in the Tsaang gubat case?

options.fil: Gayahin ang lumang timpla nang walang pagsusuri.
options.en: Copy an old recipe without assessment.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Maaaring maantala o mapalitan ang kinakailangang pangangalaga. 2: Kumpirmahin ang identity, sintomas at saklaw bago magpayo. 3: Hindi kapalit ng kasalukuyang clinical guidance ang lumang timpla.
check.feedback_en: 1: Necessary care may be displaced or delayed. 2: Confirm identity, symptoms and scope before advice. 3: An old recipe does not replace current clinical guidance.

sections.takeaway_fil: Subukan ang gawain at balikan ang resulta.
sections.takeaway_en: Try the task and review the result.
